reset_window.title: Abandon our Empire?
reset_window.message: Are you sure you want to leave your empire? Everything you have achieved will be lost forever!

info.city_message:
Provides space for <norm>{city_space} people</norm>.
 Conquered city takes <norm>{city_repair} months</norm> to repair.
info.might_message: Total military might of our empire.
info.happiness_message: Low happiness will drive our people to rebel and flee the realm, while high happiness will cause our numbers to flourish.
info.readiness_message: Our armies can attack once per month. After that, they become exhausted.

population_tooltip.title: Population
population_tooltip.no_space_message: Our dwellings are full. Build more or conquer new land.
population_tooltip.exceeded_space_message: Our people have nowhere to live and are leaving our empire.

card_abandon_empire.title: Abandon Empire
card_abandon_empire.message: Leave our people behind and found a new empire.

card_taxes.title: Taxes
card_taxes.flavor_text: We can raise or lower the taxes upon our people, though it will heavily influence their happiness.
card_taxes.effect_lenient: Lowers taxes by <neg>{tax}%</neg>, rises happiness by <pos>{happiness}%</pos>.
card_taxes.effect_oppressive: Rises taxes by <pos>{tax}%</pos>, reduces happiness by <neg>{happiness}%</neg>.

card_rations.title: Rations
card_rations.flavor_text: We can adjust the monthly food rations of our people, which will directly influence their happiness and the growth rate of the realm.
card_rations.effect_meager: Each ration sustains <pos>{food}</pos> citizens. Reduces population growth by <neg>{people}%</neg> and happiness by <neg>{happiness}%</neg>.
card_rations.effect_bountiful: Each ration sustains <neg>{food}</neg> citizens. Rises population growth by <pos>{people}%</pos> and happiness by <pos>{happiness}%</pos>.
